Entire rectangular card fills canvas edge to edge, no tabletop, no perspective, no shadows outside. Luxurious antique engraved botanical silver-gold thin border, cream top title band, richly detailed painterly fantasy creature illustration occupying middle 70%, cream bottom ability panel, tiny PRISM ARCHIVE footer. Delicate ink engraving, luminous elegant fairy-tale natural-history illustration, sophisticated jewel colours and crisp serif lettering. This belongs to the same visual collection as a vintage celestial fox card. No holographic glare baked in: real-time foil will be applied later. No existing franchise characters or logos. High detail.
Subject and scene: A sleek black panther with subtle golden rosettes prowling among night-blooming white flowers, emerald eyes, deep blue jungle.
Exact printed text: top title "ONYXAR", subtitle "NIGHT PANTHER". Upper right small medallion "245". Bottom panel title "Onyx Nocturne" and short italic "A little light. An extraordinary world." Footer "PRISM ARCHIVE" and "028 / 030". Spell these correctly. ONE complete card only.
